Find spelling and grammar errors in the translations. Each SEGMENT block holds one translation between its TEXT markers.
Reply with only a JSON array of {"segment","kind","quote","explanation","suggestion"}. segment is the number after SEGMENT.
kind is "spelling" or "grammar". Reply [] when there is no error.
quote is the shortest wrong span copied exactly from the TEXT of that segment, never an offset and never from the original.
explanation is one short sentence in the language of the translation; suggestion is the corrected span.
<<<SEGMENT 1
<<<TEXT
Cau thu nhat.
TEXT>>>
SEGMENT>>>
<<<SEGMENT 2
<<<TEXT
Cau thu hai
co hai dong.
TEXT>>>
SEGMENT>>>
